ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, points B and D are on the ray AM, points C and E are on the ray AN, and AB=BC=CD=DE. Given that $\angle EDM=84^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle A$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
Solution: Since $AB=BC=CD=DE$, \\
it follows that $\angle A=\angle BCA$, $\angle CBD=\angle BDC$, $\angle ECD=\angle CED$,\\
according to the exterior angle theorem, $\angle A+\angle BCA=\angle CBD$, $\angle A+\angle CDB=\angle ECD$, $\angle A+\angle CED=\angle EDM$,\\
additionally, since $\angle EDM=84^\circ$,\\
thus, $\angle A+3\angle A=84^\circ$,\\
solving this gives $\angle A=\boxed{21^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: Use equal-vector direction sums rather than exterior-angle chasing. From the image, take AM/DM as the positive horizontal direction and let α=∠A, the direction angle of ray AN. From the text, all four segments AB, BC, CD, DE have the same length. Let the direction of BC be β, the direction of CD be γ, and the direction of DE be θ measured from the positive AM direction. Because A and C both lie on ray AN, the vector AC is the sum of two equal-length vectors AB and BC; the direction of the sum of two equal vectors is the angle bisector of their directions, so α=(0+β)/2 and β=2α. Because B and D both lie on the lower ray AM, the vector BD=BC+CD is horizontal; with BC slanting up and CD slanting down as shown, its direction average is 0, so (2α+γ)/2=0 and γ=-2α. Because C and E both lie on ray AN, the vector CE=CD+DE has direction α; hence (-2α+θ)/2=α, so θ=4α. The image shows θ is exactly ∠EDM, and the text gives θ=84°, so 4α=84° and α=21°.

推理：取 AM/DM 的水平向右方向为 0°，设 α=∠A，即射线 AN 的方向角。设 BC 的方向角为 β，CD 的方向角为 γ，DE 的方向角为 θ，四条等长线段长度相同。因为 A、C 都在射线 AN 上，向量 AC=AB+BC，且 AB 与 BC 等长；两个等长向量的和方向是它们方向角的角平分方向，所以 α=(0+β)/2，因此 β=2α。因为 B、D 都在水平射线 AM 上，向量 BD=BC+CD 的方向为水平 0°；图中 BC 向上倾斜、CD 向下倾斜，所以它们等长向量和的方向角满足 (β+γ)/2=0，即 (2α+γ)/2=0，因此 γ=-2α。因为 C、E 都在射线 AN 上，向量 CE=CD+DE 的方向为 α；同理 α=(γ+θ)/2=(-2α+θ)/2，所以 θ=4α。图中 θ 正是 ∠EDM，题给 ∠EDM=84°，因此 4α=84°，解得 α=21°。所以 ∠A=21°。

verify_reports.critic_suggestions: 推理整体正确，结论与标准答案一致，并且基本严格遵循了指定的等长向量方向和方法。图像描述先于推理，满足“先描述图像，再推理”的要求。唯一可微调处是：图中并未用刻痕直接标出 AB=BC=CD=DE 和 84°，这些主要来自题干文字；可将“标注给出”改为“题干给出”，以避免把文字条件误说成图像标注。另外，使用方向角平均时可补充一句“由图可知相关方向夹角小于 180°，取图中所示的角平分方向”，使分支选择更严谨。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, points B and D are on the ray AM, points C and E are on the ray AN, and $AB=BC=CD=DE$. Given that $\angle EDM=84^\circ$, what is the measure of $\angle A$ in degrees?
raw_record.answer: Solution: Since $AB=BC=CD=DE$, it follows that $\angle A=\angle BCA$, $\angle CBD=\angle BDC$, and $\angle ECD=\angle CED$. According to the exterior angle theorem, $\angle A+\angle BCA=\angle CBD$, $\angle A+\angle CDB=\angle ECD$, and $\angle A+\angle CED=\angle EDM$. Since $\angle EDM=84^\circ$, we get $\angle A+3\angle A=84^\circ$, so $\angle A=\boxed{21^\circ}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, A, B, D, M are on the same lower horizontal ray AM, in the order A, B, D, M; C, E, N are on the same upper oblique ray AN, in the order A, C, E, N. In the figure, BC, CD, DE are connected, forming a broken line from B to C to D to E, and AB=BC=CD=DE is given, and angle EDM is the angle at point D formed by DE and the rightward DM.

Reasoning: Let ∠A=x. Because AB=BC, triangle ABC is an isosceles triangle, so ∠BCA=x. Since B, D are on line AM, ∠CBD is the exterior angle of triangle ABC at point B, so ∠CBD=∠A+∠BCA=x+x=2x. Also because BC=CD, triangle BCD is an isosceles triangle, so ∠BDC=∠CBD=2x. Since A, C, E are on the same straight line, ∠ECD is the exterior angle of triangle ACD at point C, so ∠ECD=∠CAD+∠CDA=x+2x=3x. Also because CD=DE, triangle CDE is an isosceles triangle, so ∠CED=∠ECD=3x. Finally, D, M are on the extension of AD, so ∠EDM is the exterior angle of triangle ADE at point D; therefore ∠EDM=∠A+∠AED=x+3x=4x. It is known that ∠EDM=84°, so 4x=84°, solving gives x=21°.
